examples_extra: Today is a very special day for us.
The restaurant has a special menu tonight.

meaning_en: Food with a strong, hot taste.
example_en: I like spicy food, like chili.
examples_extra: This curry is too spicy for me.
She really likes hot and spicy Mexican food.

meaning_en: A green leafy vegetable.
example_en: Popeye eats spinach to get strong.
examples_extra: Fresh spinach is very rich in iron.
She added fresh spinach to the salad.

meaning_en: The first small course of a meal.
example_en: I'll have soup as a starter.
examples_extra: We both ordered soup as a starter.
Our delicious starters arrived very quickly indeed.

meaning_en: Mix food or liquid with a spoon.
example_en: Please stir your tea with a spoon.
examples_extra: Stir the hot soup until it boils.
She stirred two sugars into her tea.

meaning_en: Food that is heavy, filling, and not easily digested.
example_en: The cake was a bit stodgy.
examples_extra: The pudding was too stodgy for me.
Avoid eating stodgy food before the race.

meaning_en: A small, red, sweet fruit.
example_en: I love eating fresh strawberries.
examples_extra: She really loves fresh strawberry ice cream.
Our garden strawberries are ripe right now.

meaning_en: A small, red, sweet fruit.
example_en: My favorite fruit is strawberry.
examples_extra: Would you like strawberry or chocolate cake?
Fresh strawberries always taste best in summer.

meaning_en: A sweet white substance used in food and drinks.
example_en: Do you want sugar in your coffee?
examples_extra: Do you take sugar in your tea?
Too much sugar is bad for you.

meaning_en: Containing a lot of sugar; very sweet.
example_en: Sugary drinks are not good for your teeth.
examples_extra: These cereals are too sugary.
I don't like sugary drinks.

meaning_en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
example_en: This cake is very sweet and delicious.
examples_extra: The tea is too sweet.
She likes sweet desserts after dinner.

meaning_en: Sense the flavor of food or drink.
example_en: Can you taste the salt in this soup?
examples_extra: Please taste this hot soup.
Good chefs taste the food.

meaning_en: Having no flavor or a very bad flavor.
example_en: This soup is tasteless; it needs salt.
examples_extra: This soup is quite tasteless.
He wore a tasteless tie.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant and good flavor.
example_en: This cake is very tasty.
examples_extra: This cake is very tasty.
Michel's food is very tasty.

meaning_en: A hot drink made from tea leaves.
example_en: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples_extra: I prefer coffee to tea.
She drinks green tea daily.

meaning_en: A soft red fruit used as a vegetable.
example_en: I like tomatoes in my salad.
examples_extra: She sliced a ripe tomato for the salad.
Fresh tomatoes grow best in warm sunny weather.

meaning_en: A soft red fruit used as a vegetable.
example_en: Do you want tomatoes in your sandwich?
examples_extra: Add two chopped tomatoes to the pasta sauce.
He grows sweet tomatoes in his small garden.

meaning_en: Not cooked enough; still raw inside.
example_en: The chicken was undercooked and unsafe to eat.
examples_extra: This chicken is clearly undercooked.
The rice was badly undercooked.

meaning_en: Not cooked enough, especially meat.
example_en: I prefer my steak a little underdone.
examples_extra: The steak was badly underdone.
She likes her meat slightly underdone.

meaning_en: Not fully developed or ready to eat.
example_en: These bananas are still unripe.
examples_extra: These bananas are still unripe.
The mangoes were unripe and sour.

meaning_en: meat from a young cow
example_en: Veal is often used in Italian cooking.
examples_extra: Veal is meat from a young cow.
She ordered veal at the restaurant.

meaning_en: a person who eats no animal products
example_en: My sister is a vegan and eats only plants.
examples_extra: She has been vegan for years.
Many vegans avoid all animal products.

meaning_en: a plant or part of a plant used as food
example_en: Carrots and potatoes are vegetables.
examples_extra: You should eat more fresh vegetable(s).
Vegetable(s) are good for you.

meaning_en: a person who does not eat meat
example_en: My friend is a vegetarian.
examples_extra: She has been a vegetarian for ten years.
Many vegetarians avoid all meat and fish.

meaning_en: a sour liquid used in cooking and salads
example_en: I like vinegar on my chips.
examples_extra: Add a little vinegar to the green salad.
White vinegar has a sharp, sour taste indeed.

meaning_en: used to express impatience or eagerness
example_en: "Dinner will be ready soon." "When!"
examples_extra: When! We've been waiting for ages.
'When!' she shouted very impatiently.

meaning_en: An alcoholic drink made from grapes.
example_en: Do you like red wine?
examples_extra: They drank a bottle of wine.
She prefers red wine to beer.

meaning_en: Choosing separate dishes from a menu, not a set meal.
example_en: We ordered à-la-carte, choosing different dishes.
examples_extra: We ordered some à-la-carte dishes instead.
The restaurant offers à-la-carte meals.

meaning_en: A substance added to food to improve it.
example_en: Many processed foods contain artificial additives.
examples_extra: This juice has no additives.
Some food additives can cause allergies.

meaning_en: All the necessary qualities for something to happen.
example_en: The team has all the ingredients of a champion.
examples_extra: The film has all the ingredients of a hit.
She has all the ingredients of a leader.

meaning_en: Having an adverse physical reaction to certain substances.
example_en: She is allergic to peanuts.
examples_extra: She is allergic to peanuts.
He had an allergic reaction.

meaning_en: A damaging immune response to a substance.
example_en: His severe nut allergy requires an EpiPen.
examples_extra: Pollen triggers his allergy every spring.
She developed an allergy to cats.

meaning_en: The physical and mental well-being of animals.
example_en: Consumers are increasingly concerned about animal welfare in farming.
examples_extra: The charity promotes animal welfare.
Animal welfare laws are strict here.

meaning_en: Keeping farm animals in small cages for mass production.
example_en: Many consumers oppose battery farming due to ethical concerns.
examples_extra: Battery farming is cruel and unnecessary.
They strongly oppose battery farming.

meaning_en: Pre-prepared food requiring little cooking.
example_en: Busy people often rely on convenience food for quick meals.
examples_extra: Busy parents rely on convenience food.
Convenience food saves time but costs more.
note_fa: غذای آماده؛ با convenient هم‌خانواده است.

meaning_en: To invent a false story or excuse.
example_en: He tried to cook up a story to explain his absence.
examples_extra: He cooked up a story about being ill.
She cooked up an excuse for being late.
note_fa: اصطلاح: سرهم کردن داستان یا بهانه دروغین.

meaning_en: System ensuring producers in developing countries get a fair price.
example_en: She only buys fair trade coffee to support ethical practices.
examples_extra: She only buys fair trade coffee.
Fair trade ensures farmers get a fair price.

meaning_en: (Animals) allowed to move freely, not confined.
example_en: We only buy free-range eggs from local farms.
examples_extra: We always buy free-range eggs.
Free-range chickens roam outside daily.

meaning_en: Not containing gluten, a protein found in grains.
example_en: Many people choose a gluten-free diet for health reasons.
examples_extra: She eats only gluten-free bread.
This restaurant offers gluten-free meals.

meaning_en: Cook food directly over or under strong heat.
example_en: We decided to grill some chicken for dinner.
examples_extra: She grilled the fish perfectly.
We grilled vegetables for dinner.
note_fa: کباب کردن روی حرارت مستقیم؛ grill somebody یعنی «بازجویی سخت».

meaning_en: Not fully planned or thought out; incomplete.
example_en: His half-baked plan was destined to fail.
examples_extra: It was a half-baked plan.
She rejected the weak half-baked idea.

meaning_en: Full of juice; succulent and moist.
example_en: This peach is incredibly ripe and juicy.
examples_extra: These oranges are sweet and juicy.
She told me all the juicy gossip.

meaning_en: Something one likes or finds enjoyable.
example_en: Horror films are not really my cup of tea.
examples_extra: Honestly, opera just isn't my cup of tea.
Relaxed weekend golf is exactly my cup of tea.
note_fa: مورد علاقه من؛ چیزی که دوست داری.

meaning_en: Information on food packaging about its nutritional content.
example_en: Always check the nutrition label before buying packaged food.
examples_extra: Always check the nutrition label before buying.
Each nutrition label lists calories very clearly.

meaning_en: A substance added to food to prevent spoilage.
example_en: Many processed foods contain artificial preservatives.
examples_extra: This jam contains no preservative.
They avoid food with added preservative.
note_fa: نگهدارنده؛ ماده جلوگیری از فساد غذا.

meaning_en: To make something more interesting or exciting.
example_en: Let's spice up the presentation with some visuals.
examples_extra: A karaoke machine will spice up the party.
She spiced up her speech with jokes.

meaning_en: A dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly.
example_en: My grandmother makes a delicious beef stew.
examples_extra: She made a delicious beef stew.
Let him stew for a while.
note_fa: دو معنی: خورش؛ و در عذاب گذاشتن.

meaning_en: To suffer the consequences of your own actions.
example_en: Let him stew in his own juice for a while.
examples_extra: Let him stew in his own juice.
She left them to stew in their own juice.

meaning_en: Food packaging showing nutritional values with red, amber, green.
example_en: Traffic-light labelling helps consumers make healthier food choices.
examples_extra: The traffic-light labelling shows fat and sugar levels.
Check the traffic-light labelling on food packaging.
note_fa: یعنی «برچسب چراغ راهنما» روی مواد غذایی.

meaning_en: Not treated or refined; natural.
example_en: Eating unprocessed foods is generally healthier.
examples_extra: Eat more unprocessed foods every day.
The survey data is still completely unprocessed.

meaning_en: Unpleasant or morally questionable.
example_en: He was involved with some unsavoury characters.
examples_extra: He has an unsavoury reputation.
Avoid that unsavoury part of town.

meaning_en: Food that has been processed or refined as little as possible.
example_en: Eating wholefoods is beneficial for your health.
examples_extra: She buys wholefood products weekly.
Wholefood shops sell organic grains.

meaning_en: Promoting health or moral well-being; healthy and good.
example_en: She prefers wholesome meals over fast food.
examples_extra: They serve wholesome hot meals.
It's a wholesome family show.
